evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-2h runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0.
No cost-complete, money-weighted realised net P&L by strategy, chain, asset, and notional.
No terminal attempt ledger joining signal, quote, simulation, submission, receipt/signature, fills, unwind, and all incurred costs.
No explicit split of STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures, with paid failure costs reconciled into net P&L.
No Solana contemporaneous round-trip executable quotes, liquidity, sellability, price impact, priority/Jito fee, rent, expiry, and failed-signature evidence.
No EVM quote-to-realised edge-capture distribution covering base fee, priority fee, builder payment, replacements, reverts, and inclusion latency.
No out-of-sample regime coverage, drawdown distribution, tail loss, capital-weighted return, or confidence bounds.

Before any promotion: require fresh runtime evidence, cost completeness, deduplicated terminal outcomes, positive money-weighted net P&L after every cost, acceptable profit factor and drawdown, bounded execution-failure rate, stable out-of-sample results, and chain-specific liquidity/sellability validation.

proposals.downside_risk: More observations will be classified as cost-incomplete and remain SHADOW; attribution errors could double-count costs unless transaction identifiers are deduplicated.

evidence.detail: Windows store fees, slippage, net profit, and execution-failure counts, but have no explicit price-impact, gas/priority-fee, failed-attempt-cost, rent, or cost-completeness fields.
Promotion candidacy depends on aggregate net profit and profit factor without requiring complete cost provenance or an acceptable execution-failure rate.
Quote-simulated net is derived from notional multiplied by expected net-edge bps; it is explicitly not realised P&L.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents promotion from incomplete cost accounting and makes Solana and EVM results economically comparable without conflating failure causes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 3 independent market-regime windows and 30 terminal executable attempts per chain and strategy, including failures; retain SHADOW if fewer than 10 completed round trips are available.
proposals.rationale: A strategy can appear positive when omitted chain costs or failed attempts are material. Preserve separate cause labels: completed-trade adverse movement is STRATEGY/MARKET loss; RPC, simulation, broadcast, revert, expiry, or confirmation failure is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Any fee actually paid by the latter must still reduce money-weighted net P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW windows with per-attempt cost completeness. For EVM include swap/LP fees, realised price impact, gas, priority fee, builder payment, revert cost, and replacement transactions. For Solana include swap fees, priority/Jito fees, price impact, rent effects, and failed-signature fees. Stop and mark the window invalid if any submitted attempt lacks a deduplicated terminal outcome or cost provenance. Pass only if money-weighted net P&L remains positive and profit factor exceeds the research threshold after all costs.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote sampling may overstate fill quality and create selection bias; rapid pools may make observations stale before execution.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events deliberately set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity, and sellability to zero and expose no executable outcome.
Solana observations are labelled SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE and require a quote feature adapter.
Common eligibility correctly requires positive cost-adjusted edge plus liquidity, sellability, and quote freshness, so missing Solana measurements fail closed.

proposals.expected_effect: Allows falsifiable Solana research while retaining abstention whenever an executable round-trip edge cannot be demonstrated.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 timestamped candidates across 7 days and multiple congestion/liquidity regimes, with at least 30 fully costed executable round-trip simulations and explicit missing-data counts.
proposals.rationale: Leader history or positive-trade ratio is not a contemporaneous executable edge. Solana needs decision-time round-trip quotes and chain-specific costs, including priority/Jito fees, price impact, token-account rent effects, quote expiry, blockhash expiry, and failed-signature fees.
proposals.shadow_test: At each candidate timestamp capture buy and immediately sellable unwind quotes at the same proposed size, liquidity/sellability checks, price impact, all fees, and a latency reserve. Compare predicted net with later simulated or observed executable outcomes without submitting trades. Fail the hypothesis if cost-complete median prediction error consumes the edge, failure probability makes expected net non-positive, or sellability cannot be revalidated.

proposals.downside_risk: Strict cost completeness and regime stratification may leave few eligible samples; simulated fills may still differ from mempool competition.

evidence.detail: EVM expected fees include estimated gas and builder payment, while slippage and price impact depend on source-row inputs.
An exact quote plus simulation is marked outcome_available even though it is not a realised execution outcome.
Live-cycle simulation reserves 30 percent above estimated gas and rejects routes whose quoted edge cannot cover gas plus minimum profit.

proposals.expected_effect: Calibrates quoted edge against executable outcomes and identifies whether losses are MARKET/STRATEGY decay or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 cost-complete terminal opportunities per supported EVM chain across 7 days, with congestion and volatility strata and no more than 5 percent unattributed attempts.
proposals.rationale: The EVM execution gate is conservative, but quote/simulation success cannot establish durable net profitability under state movement, inclusion latency, reverts, replacements, and dynamic base/priority fees.
proposals.shadow_test: Record immutable decision-time quotes and simulations, then measure terminal counterfactual or realised route economics using contemporaneous gas, priority fee, builder payment, price impact, slippage, and failure costs. Stratify MARKET/STRATEGY misses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Stop if lower-confidence-bound money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, realised edge capture is below 50 percent, or submitted-attempt failure rate exceeds 5 percent.
proposals.strategy: EVM Cross Venue Net Arbitrage and Learned Route Replication

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote a strategy because its raw win count or positive-trade ratio is high.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores loss magnitude, capital weighting, fees, price impact, and execution failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat exact quotes and successful simulations as realised profitability evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: They omit inclusion latency, state changes, failed attempts, and realised unwind economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force participation to satisfy a minimum trade count.
rejected_ideas.reason: No trade is preferable when positive executable edge is absent; sample thresholds must never manufacture exposure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use EVM gas assumptions unchanged for Solana.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority/Jito fees, rent, blockhash expiry, account creation, and transaction failure economics require separate accounting.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed, requires positive estimated net edge, preserves sellability/liquidity/simulation controls, and avoids optimizing raw win count. However, current SHADOW accounting is not sufficient to establish durable money-weighted net P&L: Solana has no current executable-edge adapter, EVM simulated outcomes are not realised outcomes, execution failures are not economically charged to strategy results, and Strategy Lab promotion thresholds do not require chain-specific cost completeness or bound execution-failure rates. STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be measured from successfully executed positions after all costs; EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures must be reported separately while also charging any incurred gas, priority fees, rent, or failed-transaction costs to net P&L. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported.
